entities.name: Ronald
entities.description: Human farmer from Eldraine, husband of Alyse and stepfather of Kellan.

entities.name: Browns
entities.description: Neighbors from whom Ronald got tea.

events.summary: Kellan returns home injured by bullies; Ronald fetches water, notes cold iron and yew injuries, and reassures him about his identity.
events.quote: Ronald quickly responded by fetching water and assisting his wife in caring for Kellan’s wounds.

events.summary: Kellan returns from his quest and Ronald drops his axe to embrace him.
events.quote: Ronald eagerly dropped his axe upon spotting his stepson and ran to embrace him.

relations.quote: steadfast and compassionate husband of Alyse
